name: Return to Rorian
summary: Yala Windwatcher sends you to Thendal Grove with urgent news from the field. After you help drive back the agitators on Zephras Isle, she reports that the Al'Aketh have disturbed the local wind spirits.

sections.title: A Dire Report
sections.body: Yala Windwatcher remains on Zephras Isle to face the hostiles still there. She sends you to Thendal Grove with word that the Al'Aketh are no longer working only in the shadows.

sections.title: Escalation at the Standing Stones
sections.body: Rorian the Dayseeker says Thendal Grove's leaders have watched the Al'Aketh from a distance for some time. Now the cultists have stirred native wind spirits near the standing stones. That marks a troubling escalation, and the leaders can no longer watch from afar.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Rorian?
faq.answer: After you help suppress the hostile agitators threatening the area, Yala Windwatcher sends you to report to Rorian.

faq.q: Where is Rorian the Dayseeker located?
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker is in Thendal Grove, where the grove's leaders oversee affairs on Zephras Isle.
The Al'Aketh are a cult on Zephras Isle. The grove's leaders watched them quietly from afar, but their recent agitation of wind spirits near the standing stones has made them an active threat.

faq.q: Why was Rorian not surprised by the news?
faq.answer: Rorian and the grove's leaders already knew of the cult's movements across the island. Until now, they watched quietly instead of confronting the cult directly.

faq.q: What happens after reporting back to Rorian?
faq.answer: After hearing your report and thanking you for aiding Thendal Grove, Rorian sends you to Aetheen of the Gales, a member of the Council of Elders who has been watching you.
Yala Windwatcher stays at the conflict site to deal with any stragglers while sending you ahead with the urgent news.

angles.text: As a Shaman, you know the Al'Aketh's deliberate agitation of wind spirits threatens elemental balance.
As a Druid, you share the duty to defend Thendal Grove and preserve peace in Zephras Isle's sacred grounds.
